drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (steps, submit shapes), the shipped list rows in tools/workflows/kit-lists.json; values synthetic
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:prove-the-launch-on-the-real-url for my bakery site at https://example.com: read the live page, check it for search and answer engines, check phone, tablet and desktop, and count my launch checklist."

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: No live tool sends an Instagram direct-message reply.
values.chosen: Handed 3 checked replies to the person to send by hand.
values.evidence: The live catalog has no send tool for Instagram direct messages.

values.chosen: Submitted status needs_login and pulled nothing.

alike: a blockers column on a board

no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Make sure record:business-setup:facts exists with your attached domain (workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion writes it) and that list:business-setup-checklist holds one row per stage (pour the example rows, see pour, or make the list from them).

2. Say "Run workflow:prove-the-launch-on-the-real-url". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps in order: read-facts, read-the-live-page, check-search-and-answer-readiness, check-every-width, measure-the-checklist, record-the-stage.

3. Read each step: the live page must answer 200 with its title; every failing search-readiness check or width problem is fixed in the page rows, the page is published again, and the step is run again.
4. Read the count from measure-the-checklist (done, total and the stages not done); record-the-stage writes the stage and any open gaps to list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps.

worked_examples.title: The real address answers 200 with its title
worked_examples.ask: Prove my launch on the real address.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (step read-the-live-page): facts.domain is example.com, so the step calls tool:read-public-web-page with {"url":"https://example.com"} on the real address, not a local copy.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
